findings: In `historical_glyphs.items[0]` (`ba-oracle`, attachment 1) and `items[1]` (`fu-oracle`, attachment 2), revise the captions and selection reasons to identify these as redraws of the separate component graphs only. The current captions say they illustrate components “in 爸,” which risks making the images appear to evidence those components’ roles in the compound. Keep the proposed 父 meaning and 巴 sound analyses attributed to their separate cited evidence; cite redraw provenance for what the images depict.
